spans.s: शुंशुमार m. A porpoise; (probably a corruption of शिशुमार).
शुंग m. 1. The Indian fig tree; 2. the awn of corn.
शुंगा f. 1. The sheath of a young bud; 2. the awn of corn.
शुंगिन् m. The Indian fig tree.
शुंठि f. Dry ginger.
शुंठि f. Dry ginger.
शुंठ्य n. Dry ginger.
शुंड m. 1. The juice flowing from the temples of an elephant; 2. an elephant’s proboscis.
शुंडा f. 1. An elephant’s proboscis; 2. spirituous liquor; 3. a liquor-shop; 4. the stalk of the lotus; 5. a harlot; 6. a bawd, a procuress.
शुंडक m. 1. A distiller; 2. a kind of martial instrument of music.
शुंडा-पान n. a tavern, a liquor-shop.
शुंडार m. 1. a distiller; 2. an elephant’s proboscis.
शुंडाल m. An elephant.
शुंडिका f. The same as शुंडा q.v.
शुंडिन् m. 1. A distiller; 2. an elephant.
शुंडिन्-मूषिका f. the musk-rat.
शुन् vt. 6P (pres. शुनति) To go, to move.
शुनःशेप(फ) m. Name of a Vedic sage.
शुनःशेप(फ) m. Name of a Vedic sage.
शुनक m. 1. Name of a sage; 2. a dog.
शुनासी(शी)र m. 1. An epithet of Indra; 2. an owl.
शुनासी(शी)र m. 1. An epithet of Indra; 2. an owl.
सुनासी(शी)र m. An epithet of Indra.
सुनासी(शी)र m. An epithet of Indra.
शुनि m. A dog.
शुनी f. A female dog, a bitch.
शुनीर m. A number of female dogs.
शुन्ध् vt. or vi. 1U, 10U (pres. शुंधति-ते, शुंधयति-ते) 1. To be purified; 2. to purify.
शुन्ध्यु m. Air, wind.
शुन्य a. The same as शून्य q.v.

शून्य (I) a. (f. न्या) 1. Void, empty; 2. vacant, nonexistent; 3. devoid of, deprived of, without, रजो विश्रामयन् राज्ञां छत्रशून्येषु मौलिषु R.iv.85; 4. lonely, desolate, private, शून्यं वासगृहं विलोक्य Am.
; 5. indifferent; 6. guileless; 7. absent-minded, vacant-minded, शून्या जगाम भवनाभिमुखी कथांचित् K.S.iii.75; 8. nonsensical, unmeaning; 9. naked, bare.
शून्य (II) n. 1. A void, a vacuum; 2. the sky, the atmosphere; 3. non-entity; 4. a cipher.

शून्य (I) a. (f. न्या) 1. Void, empty; 2. vacant, nonexistent; 3. devoid of, deprived of, without, रजो विश्रामयन् राज्ञां छत्रशून्येषु मौलिषु R.iv.85; 4. lonely, desolate, private, शून्यं वासगृहं विलोक्य Am.
; 5. indifferent; 6. guileless; 7. absent-minded, vacant-minded, शून्या जगाम भवनाभिमुखी कथांचित् K.S.iii.75; 8. nonsensical, unmeaning; 9. naked, bare.
शून्या f. 1. A hollow reed; 2. a barren woman.
शुंभ m. Name of a demon killed by Durgā.
शुंभ-घातिनी, -मर्दिनी f. an epithet of Durgā.
शुंभ-घातिनी, -मर्दिनी f. an epithet of Durgā.
शून a. (f. ना) 1. Swollen; 2. increased, prospered.
शून a. (f. ना) 1. Swollen; 2. increased, prospered.

शूना f. 1. The soft palate; 2. a slaughter-house; 3. a piece of house-hold furniture which destroys animal life; (five such are enumerated- पंच शूना गृहस्थस्य चुल्ली पेषण्युपस्करः । कंडनी चोदकुंभश्च).
सून (I) a. (f. ना) 1. Born, produced; 2. blown, blossomed, budded; 3. empty, vacant, (probably for शून or शून्य in this sense).
सून (II) n. 1. Bringing forth, parturition; 2. a bud, a blossom.
सून (I) a. (f. ना) 1. Born, produced; 2. blown, blossomed, budded; 3. empty, vacant, (probably for शून or शून्य in this sense).

सूना (I) f. 1. Shambles, a slaughter-house, भवानपि सूनापरिचर इव गृध्र आमिषलोलुपो भीरुकश्च Mal.ii.; 2. hurting, killing; 3. uvula; 4. a zone; 5. a river; 6. mumps; 7. a ray; 8. the sale of flesh; 9. a daughter.

सूना (II) f. pl. The five tilings in a household which are supposed to injure animal life; (they are thus enumerated- पंच सूना गृहस्थस्य चुल्ली पेषण्युपस्करः । कंडनी चोदकुंभश्च M.iii.68). See पंचमहायज्ञ.
शून्य-मध्य m. a hollow reed.
शून्य-मनस्क a. absent-minded.
शून्य-मुख a. pale-faced, having a dejected countenance.
शून्य-वाद m. the doctrine of the nonexistence of anything, atheism.
शून्य-वादिन् m. 1. an atheist; 2. a Buddhist.
शून्य-हृदय a. 1. absent-minded; 2. unsuspecting.
सुनंदा f. 1. A woman; 2. name of a woman.
सुनय m. Good conduct, good policy.
सुनयन (I) a. Having beautiful eyes.
सुनयन (II) m. A deer.
सुनयना f. 1. A woman; 2. a woman having beautiful eyes.
सुनाभ (I) a. (f. भा) 1. Having a beautiful navel; 2. having a good nave or centre.
सुनाभ (II) m. 1. A mountain; 2. the Maināka mountain.
सुनाभ (I) a. (f. भा) 1. Having a beautiful navel; 2. having a good nave or centre.
सुनार m. 1. The udder of a bitch; 2. the egg of a snake; 3. a sparrow.
सुनिभृत a. (f. ता) Very lonely or private.(सुनिभृतम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of ‘very secretly or closely, very narrowly.’)
सुनिभृत a. (f. ता) Very lonely or private.(सुनिभृतम् is used as an indeclinable in the sense of ‘very secretly or closely, very narrowly.’)
सुनीत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Well-conducted, well-behaved; 2. politic.
सुनीत (II) n. 1. Good conduct, good behaviour; 2. good policy, prudence.
सुनीत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. Well-conducted, well-behaved; 2. politic.
सुनीति f. 1. Good conduct, good manners, propriety; 2. good policy.
सुनीथ (I) a. (f. था) Well-disposed, well-conducted, righteous, virtuous, moral, good.
सुनीथ (II) m. A Brāhmaṇa.
सुनीथ (I) a. (f. था) Well-disposed, well-conducted, righteous, virtuous, moral, good.
सुनील (I) a. (f. ला) Very black or blue.
सुनील (II) m. The pomegranate tree.
सुनील (I) a. (f. ला) Very black or blue.
सुनीला f. Common flax.
सुनेत्र a. (f. त्रा) Beautiful eyed.
सुनेत्र a. (f. त्रा) Beautiful eyed.
सुंदर (I) a. (f. री) 1. Beautiful, handsome, lovely; 2. right, agreeable.
सुंदर (II) m. An epithet of Kāmadeva.
सुंदर (I) a. (f. री) 1. Beautiful, handsome, lovely; 2. right, agreeable.
सुंदरी f. A beautiful woman, विसृज सुंदरि संगमसाध्वसम् Mal.iv., व्रजंति विद्याधरसुंदरीणामनंगलेखक्रिययोपयोगम् K.S.i.7. (Also सुंदरा.)
सूनरी f. A respectable woman.
सूनिन् m. 1. A butcher; 2. a hunter.
सूनु m. 1. A son, सूनुः सच्चरितः सती प्रियतमा Bhartr.ii.25; 2. a younger brother; 3. the sun; 4. the Arka plant; 5. a child, offspring; 6. a grandson.
सूनू f. A daughter.

सूनृत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. True and agreeable, सूनुः सूनृतवाक् स्रष्टुर्विससर्जोदिताश्रियम् R.i.93; 2. kind, sincere, gentle, तृणानि भूमिरुदकं वाक् चतुर्थी च सूनृता । एतान्यपि सतां गेहे नोच्छिद्यंते कदाचन M.iii.101; 3. fortunate, auspicious; 4. dear, beloved.
सूनृत (II) n. 1. True and agreeable speech, pleasant discourse, बालत्वादवितथसूनृतेन सूनोः R.viii.92; 2. auspiciousness.

सूनृत (I) a. (f. ता) 1. True and agreeable, सूनुः सूनृतवाक् स्रष्टुर्विससर्जोदिताश्रियम् R.i.93; 2. kind, sincere, gentle, तृणानि भूमिरुदकं वाक् चतुर्थी च सूनृता । एतान्यपि सतां गेहे नोच्छिद्यंते कदाचन M.iii.101; 3. fortunate, auspicious; 4. dear, beloved.
